dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You love making, uh, food, do you...

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Of course! Not to brag or anything, but my food's the best in Merusea Village! I greatly treasure the expressions everyone makes after eating my dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Hehe, in fact, I can't wait to see yours. How about it? Would you like to have a go?
